instruction: Find the status of flights traveling from Atlanta airports to Boston tomorrow.

metadata.explanation: Task variation that changes the flight route from 'New York to Columbus OH' to 'Atlanta to Boston'. The task maintains the same structure as the original: agent navigates Delta.com to search for flight status updates for a specific route tomorrow. The evaluator uses existing functions (get_active_tab_html_parse, get_rule_relativeTime, check_direct_json_object) to verify the agent successfully searched for ATL→BOS flights with tomorrow's date. ATL is Delta's major hub making this a realistic route.
metadata.changes: Only modified: instruction (ATL→BOS route), expected airports (ATL, BOS). Kept same: config, evaluator structure, all getter/metric functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: start airport (ATL), end airport (BOS), and date (tomorrow)
Getter logic (get_active_tab_html_parse) correctly extracts airport codes and date from Delta.com flight status page using appropriate CSS class selectors
The class_multiObject_child extraction using safely_get_direct_text_nodes_playwright() correctly handles the HTML structure to extract ['ATL', 'BOS'] from direct text nodes
Expected value generation (get_rule_relativeTime) properly converts 'tomorrow' to absolute date with correct format {DoW}, {Month} {Day0D}, {Year}
Metric (check_direct_json_object) performs appropriate direct JSON comparison between extracted values and expected values
Data flow is semantically correct: HTML parsing → JSON extraction → comparison with expected values
The evaluator can access Chrome's active tab at runtime via Playwright and extract the needed state
Complete coverage: all three requirements (start airport, end airport, date) are verified
